title: Concept: PowerShell execution policy bypassed on the command line in powershell — review required
description: In powershell, the execution policy is bypassed. The policy is a guardrail, not a security boundary, but it is the only control that stops an unsigned download from running on a default workstation. Bypassing it in scheduled tasks normalises the same flag in interactive use.
risk: Unsigned script execution with operator privileges; MEDIUM severity.
